title: Post-incident review completion SLA
summary: Time between incident closure and submission of a complete blameless-review artifact. The clock starts when the incident-handling case is moved to a closed status and stops when the post_incident_review playbook's blameless-review-template step completes with a non-empty review artifact. Lower is better. The 30-day target is anchored on NIS2 Article 23(4)(d) and DORA Article 19(4)(c), both of which require a final report no later than one month after the (intermediate) incident notification — the review artifact is the structured input the operator's reporting compiler consumes to produce that final report.

target.rationale: Aligned with NIS2 Art. 23(4)(d) and DORA Art. 19(4)(c) one-month final-report obligations.

measurement.formula: p95( blameless_review_step.completed_at - incident.closed_at ) over closed incidents in window.

inputs.name: review_artifact
inputs.description: wall-clock duration from incident close to blameless-review-template completion

external_refs.name: NIS2 Article 23(4)(d) — final report one month after notification
DORA Article 19(4)(c) — final report one month after intermediate report
